name: univer
description: The Office Harness for AI Agents — Spreadsheets, Docs, Slides, Canvas, Relational Tables, and PDF in one runtime.
one_liner: A toolkit developers use to build their own spreadsheet, document, or slide editor directly inside their own app or website, instead of embedding Google Sheets or Excel.
buyer: A product manager at a SaaS company who needs spreadsheet or document editing built into their own product (a BI tool, internal dashboard, or AI app) without licensing Excel or Google Workspace.
business_use_cases: A SaaS analytics company embeds a live, editable spreadsheet view into their dashboard so customers can tweak formulas and see them sync with the app's data.
An agency builds a self-hosted 'internal Notion + Excel' workspace for a client who can't put sensitive data in Google's or Microsoft's cloud.
An AI startup lets its agents generate and edit spreadsheet-based mini apps (budgets, trackers) directly inside the customer's product, bound to live data.

money_ideas.idea: Build and sell a self-hostable 'collaborative workspace' product on top of it, like Univer Workspace, targeting privacy-sensitive teams.
Offer integration consulting for SaaS teams who want spreadsheet/doc editing embedded in their product.

steal_this: Spin up their open-source Workspace example this weekend, point it at one small business's messy spreadsheet process (inventory, invoicing), and pitch them a self-hosted alternative to a $50/month SaaS tool.
